notes.title: A-V2.0 Status Update 3 + Release Date
notes.notes:
Release date:

The planed release date is the 18th of this month but could be a day late.

What's been done since the last status update:

[*] Cutting down trees and mining to gather resources.

NOTE

To make the game more realistic the tress will not grow back
allowing you to clear areas for building.

[*] Full day and night system.

[*] New Build System with visual snapping indicator to let
you know when you walls are perfectly aligned.

[*] Cave systems.

[*] Fog scattering.

[*] Flash light toggle.

[*] Searchable items.

[*] Full campaign save system

[*] More realistic muzzle flash with shadows

[*] Automatic reflection updating

[*] Clear options menu

+ Lots more

notes.title: Update A-V2.0 Status Update 2
notes.notes:
Hi Community

Here are a few things we have implemented for V2.0

[*] Sniper Rifle.
This item will be unlocked after completing the one hit wonder mission in survival mode.

This weapon packs a punch with a hit taking 200 HP and a head-shot of 400 HP.
Sniper ammo will be a rare item

[*] Heaven.

After completing the intro you will be asked to find a place to call home.
this will be your haven.

During early access there will be 5 heavens to choose from (More on main release)

Heavens use a different build menu than your basic build menu.
when inside your haven you will have the option to build better walls, power generators, gardens and a lot more.

[*] Platform Support

As of A-V2.0 Damned Nation Reborn will be supported on Windows/ OSX/ Linux.

More will be announced soon.

notes.title: Update V1.95 LIVE: Release Notes
notes.notes:
Changes.

[*] Turret can now be upgraded to level 2 (walk up to a turret and press (F)

[*] Multi-storey building can now be created using box frames (5) and ladder walls (4) then climbing onto the box frame
and building on top

[*] Turrets no longer shoot through walls (Do not build wall structures in front of them unless it can be shot through such as the metal bars (3))


[*] Blood splash
[*] Bullet impact particle systems

+ More minor improvements

Remember to restart your steam client to obtain this update.

notes.title: Update A-V2.0 Status Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi Community[/h1]

I can Imagen a few of you have been panicking
as it has been a few weeks since the last update.

[h1]What have we been doing?[/h1]


[*]Walker AI has been completely rewritten.

Previous walker on Damned Nation only used 250 lines of code and has made them seem very robotic and repetitive were as new Damned Nation walkers now use over 600 lines of code.

Walkers will now

[*] Decide whether or not to be aggressive or calm
[*] Stop and look behind the and also.
[*] walkers now eat meat of the floor
Note every time a walker eats from the floor they will gain 5HP
[*] Walkers will now drag themselves across the floor

During all of these new actions walkers have different sense of awareness 

[*]A more user friendly UI and main menu.
See the performance impact with every change you make to the graphics settings

[img]https://fa948efce55f86a3d34fa954cfc24ee96db6f697.googledrive.com/host/0BzvcKUV2bmxdOTRaSjFiYlpiUWc/1.jpg[/img]


[*]More realistic rendering with gradient ambient lighting / improved physicaly based shading and volumetric clouds

[img]https://fa948efce55f86a3d34fa954cfc24ee96db6f697.googledrive.com/host/0BzvcKUV2bmxdOTRaSjFiYlpiUWc/3.jpg[/img]

[*]Nvidia PhysX

Using PhysX we have managed to increase the amount of vegetation on screen and added ivy hanging from power cables and under bridges.
We have also added old ripped banners on buildings.

NOTE this feature will have a noticeable performance hit and is designed for the more high end PC users (Can be toggled on and of in the options menu)

[img]https://fa948efce55f86a3d34fa954cfc24ee96db6f697.googledrive.com/host/0BzvcKUV2bmxdOTRaSjFiYlpiUWc/4.jpg[/img]

[*]Expanding on the open-world map

This is just a few of the improvements we have made and more will be revealed in the new Alpha V2.0 Trailer 


[h1]A few more screens[/h1]

[img]https://fa948efce55f86a3d34fa954cfc24ee96db6f697.googledrive.com/host/0BzvcKUV2bmxdOTRaSjFiYlpiUWc/5.jpg[/img]
[img]https://fa948efce55f86a3d34fa954cfc24ee96db6f697.googledrive.com/host/0BzvcKUV2bmxdOTRaSjFiYlpiUWc/7.jpg[/img]
[img]https://fa948efce55f86a3d34fa954cfc24ee96db6f697.googledrive.com/host/0BzvcKUV2bmxdOTRaSjFiYlpiUWc/2.jpg[/img]
